How paying works

No plans to pick. One path.

  1. 01

    Try it

    Open the terminal and type. A little free usage is on us, no sign-up.

  2. 02

    Sign in

    Get the $5 starter kit and cloud save. GitHub, Google or email; no card.

  3. 03

    Keep going

    Buy credits and pay model cost + 10%, with no account fees, or switch to your own key any time. Your key is never blocked.

Numbers marked “not final” can change before billing opens. Paying is not wired yet: until it is, free usage ends when the starter kit is spent, and your key keeps working.
